title: Screening after broadcast is forensics,
but before it's compliance
lead: A blockchain transaction cannot be recalled. So DFNS puts compliance before the point of no return. Every check runs in the transaction path, pre-signature. What fails never gets signed; what signs is already clean.

cards.title: Pre-signature screening
cards.body: AML/KYT via Chainalysis, Elliptic, Sumsub, Global Ledger, or Scorechain, evaluated before signing, not investigated after settlement.

cards.title: Travel Rule, built in
cards.body: Originator and beneficiary data exchanged through Notabene and partners as part of the transfer flow.

cards.title: Validation gates
cards.body: Independent pre-signature checkpoints where your own systems or third parties can veto a transaction before it exists.

cards.title: Cryptographic audit trails
cards.body: Every request, approval, and signature logged as a tamper-evident record; exportable, verifiable, regulator-legible.
